def cross(o, a, b):
    return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1]) - (a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])

def on_segment(p, q, r):
    # Check if q lies on segment pr
    if min(p[0],r[0]) <= q[0] <= max(p[0],r[0]) and min(p[1],r[1]) <= q[1] <= max(p[1],r[1]):
        return True
    return False

def segments_intersect(p1, p2, p3, p4):
    d1 = cross(p3, p4, p1)
    d2 = cross(p3, p4, p2)
    d3 = cross(p1, p2, p3)
    d4 = cross(p1, p2, p4)
    
    if ((d1 > 0 and d2 < 0) or (d1 < 0 and d2 > 0)) and \
       ((d3 > 0 and d4 < 0) or (d3 < 0 and d4 > 0)):
        return True
    
    if d1 == 0 and on_segment(p3, p1, p4): return True
    if d2 == 0 and on_segment(p3, p2, p4): return True
    if d3 == 0 and on_segment(p1, p3, p2): return True
    if d4 == 0 and on_segment(p1, p4, p2): return True
    
    return False

import math

def dist(p, q):
    return math.sqrt((p[0]-q[0])**2 + (p[1]-q[1])**2)

# Read input
line = input().split()
# Assuming input format: x_A y_A x_B y_B x_C y_C x_D y_D

B = (float(line[2]), float(line[3]))
C = (float(line[4]), float(line[5]))
D = (float(line[6]), float(line[7]))

if segments_intersect(A, B, C, D):

else:
